title: Wake-Up March
body: Stand tall and march gently in place, lifting each knee comfortably. Let your arms swing naturally.

title: Desk Dance
body: Stand up and sway, step side to side, and move your shoulders to an imaginary beat. No choreography needed.

title: Walk the Thought
body: Take a slow lap around your room while thinking through whatever you were working on.

title: Window Walk
body: Walk over to a window, look outside for a moment, then take a few easy steps before heading back.

title: Hallway Loop
body: Leave your workspace and take one relaxed loop down the hallway or around the room.

title: Water Break Walk
body: Grab a glass or bottle of water and make the trip there and back without rushing.

title: Toe-to-Heel Rock
body: Stand comfortably and slowly shift your weight from heels toward toes and back again.

title: Mini Squat Reset
body: Stand with feet comfortable and bend your knees slightly, then rise tall. Repeat at an easy pace.

title: Calf Pump
body: Rise onto your toes, pause briefly, and lower your heels with control. Keep the movement comfortable.

title: Leg Shakeout
body: Stand up and gently shake out one leg at a time, then settle both feet firmly on the floor.

title: Knee Lift Pause
body: Lift one knee gently, lower it, then switch sides. Keep your torso tall and use support if helpful.

title: Side-Step Reset
body: Take a few comfortable steps to one side and back, then repeat in the other direction.

title: Step & Touch
body: Step gently to the side, bring your feet together, and alternate sides while letting your arms swing.

title: March & Reach
body: March slowly in place while reaching one arm overhead at a time.

title: Reach & Release
body: Reach both hands overhead, pause, then let your arms float back down. Repeat several times.

title: Wall Reach
body: Stand near a wall and reach one hand upward, then the other. Let your ribs and shoulders move naturally.

title: Sky to Floor
body: Reach toward the ceiling, then let your arms relax toward your sides. Repeat slowly and breathe easily.

title: Hug Yourself Reset
body: Give yourself a gentle cross-body hug, switch which arm is on top, then open your arms wide.

title: Shoulder Sunrise
body: Lift your shoulders toward your ears, roll them back, and let them drop. Repeat slowly.

title: Shoulder Drawers
body: Draw slow circles with your shoulders as if polishing two small circles in the air.

title: Ear to Shoulder
body: Let one ear drift toward its shoulder, return to center, and switch sides. Keep your neck relaxed.

title: Look Left, Look Right
body: Turn your head gently to look over one shoulder, return to center, and switch sides.

title: Chin Glide
body: Sit or stand tall and gently draw your chin straight back, then relax. Keep your gaze level.

title: Chest Window
body: Open your arms wide as if making space for a big window, then relax them back down.

title: Doorway Open
body: Stand comfortably in a doorway and gently open your chest without forcing the stretch.

title: Desk to Tall
body: Start relaxed at your desk, stand up, lengthen through the crown of your head, then sit back down.

title: Spine Wave
body: While seated or standing, gently round your back and then return to a tall position in a smooth wave.

title: Seated Side Reach
body: Sit tall, reach one arm overhead and gently lean to the opposite side. Switch sides slowly.

title: Standing Side Bend
body: Stand tall and slide one hand gently down your leg while reaching the other arm upward. Switch sides.

title: Hip Figure Eight
body: Stand comfortably and draw small figure eights with your hips. Keep the movement smooth and easy.

title: Hip Shift
body: Shift your weight gently from one hip to the other while keeping both feet grounded.

title: Standing Hip Open
body: Lift one knee comfortably and move it slightly outward, then place your foot down and switch sides.

title: Chair-Free Minute
body: Stay standing for one minute. Shift your weight, stretch your arms, and let your legs enjoy the change.

title: Stand & Scan
body: Stand up and slowly look around your space. Notice three things you can see before sitting down.

title: Standing Weight Shift
body: Shift your weight forward, back, left, and right while keeping the movement small and controlled.

title: Balance Check
body: Stand near something stable and briefly shift your weight from one foot to the other.

title: Desk-Side Stretch
body: Stand beside your desk, reach one arm overhead, and gently lengthen through your side. Switch sides.

title: Chair-Back Push
body: Place your hands on the back of a sturdy chair and gently step back to lengthen your arms and back.

title: Wall Push Reset
body: Face a wall and place your hands against it. Gently bend and straighten your elbows for a few easy repetitions.

title: Countertop Pause
body: Stand at a counter, place your hands down, and gently shift your weight forward and back.

title: Fist to Fan
body: Slowly make soft fists, then spread your fingers wide like a fan. Repeat and relax your hands.

title: Finger Piano
body: Tap each fingertip gently against your thumb, moving through your fingers like playing a tiny piano.

title: Prayer to Press
body: Bring your palms together gently, hold for a moment, then release and shake your hands loose.

title: Wrist Wave
body: Let your hands move slowly through a gentle wave, then circle both wrists in each direction.

title: Far Focus
body: Look toward the farthest comfortable point in your space and let your eyes rest there for a moment.

title: Eye Tour
body: Look gently up, down, left, and right without moving your head. Finish by looking into the distance.

title: Screen to Sky
body: Lift your gaze away from the screen and look upward toward a distant point. Blink slowly and relax.

title: Slow Blink Break
body: Close your eyes softly for a moment, open them, and repeat a few slow, comfortable blinks.

title: Three-Breath Reset
body: Take three slow, comfortable breaths. Let each exhale soften your shoulders and hands.

title: Long Exhale
body: Breathe in comfortably, then let your breath out slowly. Repeat several times without forcing the pace.

title: Breath & Reach
body: Reach your arms overhead as you breathe in, then lower them as you breathe out.

title: Reset the Room
body: Stand up and put away one small item, straighten one thing, then return to your workspace.

title: Posture Photo Pose
body: Stand as if someone is about to take your picture: feet grounded, shoulders relaxed, head tall. Hold briefly.

title: Zip-Up Posture
body: Imagine a zipper gently drawing you from your hips to the top of your head. Stand tall without stiffening.

title: Crown Lift
body: Imagine a string lifting the crown of your head upward while your shoulders stay relaxed.

title: Sit-to-Stand Flow
body: Stand from your chair, pause tall, then sit back down with control. Repeat at a comfortable pace.

title: Stand, Reach & Walk
body: Stand up, reach overhead, then take a short walk around your space before returning.

title: One-Minute Explore
body: Walk somewhere you normally overlook. Take a few steps, look around, and return when your minute is up.

title: Back-Pocket Walk
body: Put your hands comfortably behind your back or at your sides and take a relaxed walk around the room.

title: Heel-to-Toe Walk
body: Take a few slow, comfortable steps, placing your heel down before your toes. Use support if needed.

title: Movement Snack
body: Pick three moves you enjoy: a reach, a shoulder roll, and a few steps. Give each a little time.

title: Shake the Day Off
body: Stand up and gently shake out your hands, arms, shoulders, and legs. Finish with one deep breath.

title: Robot to Human
body: Start stiff and still for a moment, then gradually loosen your shoulders, arms, hips, and legs.

title: Reset Your Footprint
body: Stand and notice how your feet meet the floor. Shift gently until you find a comfortable, balanced stance.

title: Floor to Ceiling
body: Look down briefly, then lift your gaze and reach toward the ceiling. Return to neutral and repeat.

title: Side-to-Side Sway
body: Stand comfortably and sway gently from side to side. Let your arms follow the movement.

title: Tiny Twist Flow
body: Stand or sit tall and gently rotate your upper body left and right, keeping the movement relaxed.

title: Hip Back Rock
body: With feet comfortable, gently shift your hips back and return to standing tall. Keep the range small.

title: Ankle Awakening
body: Lift one heel, then the other, and finish with a few gentle ankle circles on each side.

title: Toe Spread
body: While seated or standing, relax your feet and gently spread your toes before letting them soften again.

title: Desk to Door
body: Stand up and walk to the nearest doorway. Pause, take one relaxed breath, and walk back.

title: Movement Mix
body: Combine a few shoulder rolls, a gentle reach, some marching, and a short walk. Keep everything easy.

title: Reset & Return
body: Stand, stretch your arms, take a few steps, then return to your workspace with a fresh posture.

title: The Two-Minute Detour
body: Take the scenic route to refill your water, check a window, or visit another room before returning.

title: Body Weather Check
body: Stand up and scan from head to feet. Notice where you feel tense, then give those areas a gentle movement.

title: Tiny Victory Walk
body: Stand up, take a short walk, and come back ready to tackle the next small thing on your list.
